title: The Ancient Blessing Hidden Inside Two Silver Scrolls
alternateTitle: Two Silver Amulets Hid Words Older Than the Dead Sea Scrolls

editorial.question: What exactly did the Ketef Hinnom silver amulets preserve, and how far can the evidence take us?
editorial.endingLearning: The viewer learns that the amulets are an early written witness to blessing language also found in Numbers, while the objects do not date the whole book or prove a miracle.
editorial.selectedHook: Did you know two pieces of silver, each smaller than a finger, preserved words also found in the Bible centuries before the Dead Sea Scrolls?
